translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Kinim kukuw taktakin umi sung uta ko.
“Kaba kinim kukuw uyo taktakin dakodawo Got akal kanom kam kukuw uyo taktakamoma banim keida kala.
Kale kinim taktakbaw ulum leiw makuw be ki Got akal kanom kam kukuw taktakamokaba ade kaba teng idumo teng katkat gelebaw namti, Got akal ulum kanabaw ulum yán ki abo kukamokaba ko.
Watawo kaleyo kabalam kafadow am kin alol katiw uta utamliw labaw, kata kabalam kin alol dukum ayo utamodaw banim, masi ami ban keimin be katiw taw tá, kabalami be dukum ko.
Kaba yakno nadawo kam kafadow bakodaw, ‘kala kam kin alol katiw bo kudukamon kalokabáwe?’ Kaba kalam kin alol dukum uyo ulum kanom bu bude.
Kale fong awang kaba! Kamakikiw kalam kin alol dukum usik kudu kin bá nadawo kaek fen kafadow ami kin alol uyo yak kal bu kale nadawo kudulawámin ko.

Kale kaba Got ami weng abemo kalin uyo ban keimin kinim kukáyamin bá. Kale be ulutaw kale, kaba ufek ufek abem uyo mayan kukaya bom ade kisol aungal uyo kung kukaya bom keimokabaw, kung ika kam kisol aungal bo yán tawal kutamodokabiw ade mayan ika alo asiki kumo kalokabiw.”
Kuek di dákadálawin umi weng sung uta ko.
“Kaleyo kaba dákadámokabaw aka kukamokaba ade kaba fenokabaw beta utamokabaw ade kaba gaugauyokabaw, beta yal bisukamokaba.
Yak kan ata dákadámokaba, aka bo kudulokaba ade kan ata fenokabaw, aka bo utamokaba ade kan ata gaugauyokabaw, aka yal bisudawokaba ko.
Kiba kan kawta kam man imin budet kunamo, kale dákadákamokaba uyo kaba ken tum uyo kudawodáwe?
Ade aka takamo, kale dákadákamokaba uyo kaba ken faimkun fale uyo kudawodáwe?

Kale kiba kinim mafak, kata kiba ufek ufek kidel kilim muduw kukayamin bo kilim kal. Kale atin kilim kal, kilim Kalaw abid tikin kayak aka kinim kan ata dákadálaba, aka Sinik Abem kukádawin bo alam kal.

Kaleyo kaba kalam ufek ufek uyo yak madik ita tad kidelna bom kanamamino kalbaw taw, kabal yak im ufek ufek uyo kidelya bom kanayamamal kala. Kale bela Mosus Sawa so Lum senin kinim imi kukumin so imi weng mit ade belata ka.”
Leiw dukeng so leiw dukum so umi sung uta ko.

“Kale kaba awsom dukeng leiw ata tam unalo, watawo kaleyo bá, awsom bamadálin umi leiw be bamadálin ade fitin banim ade be dew un bi as kainin abiw diba ade kinim wanang deng mak deng mak ika kal leiw abo bidiw.
Kata awsom dukeng umi leiw be atin leiw dukeng ade fitin seng. Kale leiw be dew un bi sun kuw biyámin diba ade kinim leiw utamanbiw bidi mada dabi ko.”
As so ulum gim so umi sung uta ko.
“Kiba ibakamin lum senin kinim weng uyo kidela dufo bom nadiwo ika tad katamokabiw. Ika siwsiw fibudin taw kei tadokabiw, kata im aket tem kaok utane sew mayan atud alataw keisiw ko.

Kale im kukuw kanabiw uta utam nadawo kabal kal keidomo bidi kanodin kinime yakal kala. Kale kam aket ken yet gim uyo as awyomal kal abudomane? Bade kam aket ken kimit uyo ken gakadom sok dim kal abudomane?
Kale alataw as kidel uka gim kidel abumokabu ade as mafak uka gim mafak abumokabu ko.
As kidel uyo ken gim mafak abudoma banim ade as mafak uyo ken gim kidel abudoma banim.
Kale adikum as yak gim kidel abudongin banim as be gaudiw dák bakan aba didiw yak as abokaba kala.
Kaleyo ibakamin lum senin kinim ika ilim kukuw uta kanamiwo itam ika kanodin kinime yakokabaw ka.

“Kale kinim adikum bakonam nadiw ‘Kamokim, Kamokim’ nakbiw, ika adikum yak Got ami kasák gu unokabiw bá, kata kinim wanang yak kan ita Natim abid tikin kayak ami weng ki kidilawábiw, ita kuw yak kasák gu unokabiw ko.

Kale am afung am dánan tad bada kabadák kinim seng seng ika bakonam nadiwe, ‘Kamokim, Kamokim nuka kam win tudow dim lum abem sen bom naduw ade nuka kam win tudow dim sinik mafak iyo fotaba bom naduwe kukuw makik makik seng seng uyo kanamábuwo.’ Kalokabiw.
Kata nakal bakoyamokabi. ‘Kukuw mafak fakudin kiba, nam kal banim. Kale namadá sakabin kala.’ Yakokabi ko.”
Kinim aket tetin so kinim aket dakwan so imi am ginamin sung uta ko.
Kaleyo kan kinim ata nam weng kidi nadane kudew tabe bom kitakaba namti, aka kinim aket tetin ami am ginaba, be aka tum dim kal am kun tem kidelu kadol nada ginaba taw ko.
Aka am bo ginedane weiw dukum madák abune wok fukam matam bune inim gedul umi kitid uyo kudew tad am dákabu, kata am ayo bilaloma banim. Watawo kaleyo bá, aka tum dim kal am kun kabi gineba kayo ko.
Kata kan kinim ata nam weng be kidi nadanade kudew tabe bom kitakámongin banim namti, aka kinim aket dakwan ami am kun sák wok siksik dim kadákal loklok gine kudane,
weiw dukum madák abune, wok fukam matam bune inim gedul umi kitid uyo kudew tad am dádune am uyo bila un bi dák guilokabu.”
Kale Yesus ayo kanodin weng uyo bakoda banimune, kanomin wanang kinim iyo ami kukumin weng uyo kidi nadiwe aket diking dakung bom beso kuwo kalsiw,
be watawo kaleyo bá, ami kukumin uyo sawa kukumin kinim imi kukumin taw bá, kata aka Got ami kitid so kuku badano kayo ko.
